metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘You get a prize for standing still’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I move the mouse at all?
Enemy must’ve been on a coffee break.
Click if your best plays come from pure luck and zero effort.
Valorant logic continues to confuse us all.

Tap if your aim’s asleep but the kills still happen!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
